singular VERSION (commit unknown)

Usage: singular registry COMMAND

Create a registry and act on it

The registry commands name a registry by its state token, which create prints;
every command but create takes it from --state-token or from
SINGULAR_STATE_TOKEN.

Available settings:
  Show this help text
  switch: -h|--help

Available commands:
  create     Boot a registry, or preview its identity      
  fold       Fold the pending requests into the registry   
  reject     Reject all pending requests past their windows
  reclaim    Take back your own pending request            
  inspect    Read the registry and a key back              
  describe   Print the registry page
